shortDescription: Brazilian workers in Rio de Janeiro's industrial maintenance and assembly sectors have begun a strike that includes employees at oil platforms, local union SINTPICC-RJ said on Friday.

children: Brazilian workers in Rio de Janeiro's industrial maintenance and assembly sectors have begun a strike that includes employees at oil platforms, local union SINTPICC-RJ said on Friday.
has said its oil platforms continue to produce normally, and that it is following negotiations between its contractors and the striking workers.
Workers are striking over a deadlock in labor negotiations with employers, the union said in a statement.
According to the union, strikes at oil platforms do not necessarily affect production.
